title: Maximum height calculation
description: Essential: Correctly computes the maximum height using the upward acceleration and initial velocity.

title: Gravity work recognition
description: Essential: States that the work done by gravity over the round trip is zero.

title: Air resistance work
description: Important: Calculates the total work done by air resistance, considering its constant magnitude and total distance.

title: Upward acceleration setup
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law correctly for the ascent, summing forces to find the upward acceleration.

title: Downward acceleration setup
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law correctly for the descent, summing forces to find the downward acceleration.

title: Ascent time calculation
description: Important: Uses kinematic equations with the correct upward acceleration to find the time to reach maximum height.

title: Descent time calculation
description: Important: Uses kinematic equations with the correct downward acceleration and height to find the descent time.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (meters, seconds, joules) throughout the solution.

title: Sign error in work
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns a positive sign to the work done by air resistance.

title: Acceleration magnitude confusion
description: Pitfall: Uses gravitational acceleration (g) instead of the net acceleration (a1 or a2) in kinematic equations.
